attribute_fields.COMMENTS: NorthDakota state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per N.D.C.C. § 57-38-30.3: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 2.5%. Standard deductions: $14,600 Single/MFS, $29,200 MFJ/QSS, $21,900 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " North Dakota Tax Calculation (top marginal 2.5%)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " North Dakota Tax Calculation (top marginal 2.5%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 29200.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.025
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 29200.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.025 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 21900.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.025
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 21900.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.025 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 14600.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.025
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 14600.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.025 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: ND Single/MFS: 2.5% x max(AGI - $14,600, 0) per N.D.C.C. § 57-38-30.3
